diagnosis.llm_reason: The physician discharge diagnosis is a compound statement: 'Failure to thrive; Dehydration; Acute kidney injury.' Scanning all ranks, Rank 2 'Adult failure to thrive with severe protein-calorie malnutrition and cachexia' names the same principal condition as 'Failure to thrive' (more specific, bundled with malnutrition/cachexia). Rank 3 'Hypovolemic hypotension due to dehydration and poor oral intake' also captures the dehydration component, and Rank 5 'Acute kidney injury on chronic kidney disease (prerenal)' captures the AKI component. Per the lowest-matching-rank rule, the matched rank is 2.

icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: The mapped ICD at the matched rank (Rank 2) is R62.7 (Adult failure to thrive), whereas the billed ground-truth primary code is I95.89 (Other hypotension). These are distinct principal conditions in the coding sense (nutritional/debility symptom code vs circulatory hypotension code) and a coder would not accept R62.7 as equivalent to I95.89. Note that Rank 3 does map exactly to I95.89 (hypovolemic hypotension due to dehydration), but the ICD comparison is anchored to the matched rank.
